## What

Three recorded CI flake legs root-caused and repaired — no retries
added anywhere — plus the GATE-G4 bookkeeping sweep:

**1. `credential_mediator_oauth_resolves_and_refuses` (G4-1) — real
fencepost defect, fixed.** `CredentialBroker::verify_minted` compared
`now_ms > expires_at_ms`; a zero-TTL mint (`expires_at_ms == now`)
verified `Valid` for the whole same-millisecond window instead of
`Expired` — the intermittent race behind six recorded CI firings
(R2.22–R2.26). Fixed to `>=` (the `now < exp` reading — the crate's
`live_at` and `mediate` conventions already agreed; ADR-0354 D1).
New boundary regression:
`hh-secrets::r2_10::r2_10_minted_token_expires_at_the_expiry_instant`
pins `expires_at_ms − 1` → Valid, `expires_at_ms` → Expired, zero-TTL →
Expired at mint.

**2. `ac5` `derived_from.view_hash` (G4-2) — adjudicated: allowlist
member, derivation input named.** `context.assembled` is an
observation-plane row; a later assembly's `view_hash` is the `idp/1`
stamp of the `context_view` fold over the durable prefix — which
carries earlier rows' measured `assembly_ms.value` wall (allowlisted at
R2.1). The divergence is a *derived consequence* of that member, not an
independent input; carving measured walls out of the projection would
weaken the AC-R-2.2.1-3 rebuild contract. `derived_from.view_hash`
joined the existing `ends_with` convention in
`crates/hh-cli/tests/in_process.rs` with the derivation input named in
the comment (CC1 — no second suppression mechanism). LEDGER OPEN
FINDINGS entry repaired-closed.

**3. `hh-embed r2_14` loopback `Connection reset` (G4-7) — fixture
defect, fixed.** `LocalHttpTransport` writes request head + body in two
`write_all` calls; both loopback sinks stopped reading at `\r\n\r\n`
then answered + closed — a split segment left the body in flight at
close → RST → client `read_to_end` reported `Connection reset`. Both
fixtures (`r2_14.rs`, `hh-env/egress_mediation.rs`) now consume the
declared `Content-Length` body before responding (`read_request`) —
protocol-correct, deterministic.

**Lint hygiene.** Three pre-existing clippy lints in untouched hh-env
test files (newer toolchain — `iter_last`, `too_many_arguments`,
`field_reassign_with_default`) repaired so the touched crate is clean
under `-D warnings`; the arity allow uses the convention already
carried by sibling hh-env test files.

**4. Bookkeeping sweep (G4-4/5/6).** DEFERRALS.md: 16 discharged cells
flipped `OPEN`/`PARTIAL` → `DONE` (dated `**DONE**` evidence preserved
verbatim). DF-S0.3-3 keeps `PARTIAL` — its `machine cells DONE` marker
is scoped; the R2 human-signature residual is genuinely open (BL-02).
DF-S2.4-2 gains a dated residual note naming BL-31 (`env`). BACKLOG.md
counts corrected (72 DONE / 25 OPEN / 3 PARTIAL — tokens and markers
now agree). BACKLOG.csv BL-42 homes ADR-0354 (45 standing triggers).
